quotes.en: These ratios of intervals were discovered and determined from unequal lengths or thicknesses of strings, or from the tension imparted by turning the pegs, or, what is more securely established, from weights hung from strings. In instruments that sound when blown, they were established either from the dimensions of the pipes or by strengthening and weakening the breath.

quotes.ru: Эти отношения интервалов были найдены и установлены по неодинаковой длине или толщине струн, по их натяжению при повороте колков или, что достовернее известно, при подвешивании к струнам грузов. У инструментов, звучащих, когда в них дуют, — либо по величине трубок, либо по усилению и ослаблению струи воздуха.
quotes.en: These interval ratios were discovered and ascertained from inequalities in the length or thickness of strings, or from the tension obtained by turning the tuning pegs, or, as is better established, by hanging weights from the strings. In instruments that sound when blown, they were found either from the size of the pipes or from the strengthening and slackening of the breath.

text_issues_review.proposal: (a) 'what is better ascertained'; (b) 'what has rather been found [to be the case]'.
text_issues_review.why: Better ascertained renders the comparative degree of certain knowledge. The weaker 'rather been found to be the case' is possible as a loose paraphrase of comparative preference, but it suppresses what is being compared, namely how securely each procedure established the result. The question of frequency is unexpressed.

segments.sense: The tetrachord contains the fourth’s capacities, the pentachord the fifth’s, and the octachord the entire force of the octave. The sixteen-string system spans the full double octave, with two sets of capacities: those just listed and those of the octave plus fourth, octave plus fifth, and double octave.

divergences.issue: What does intensio measure in the description of the sixteen-string system?

readings.construal: The complete tension of the double octave.

quotes.ru: Из систем же одна — тетрахорд, содержащий все возможности интервала кварты; другая — пентахорд, охватывающий возможности интервала квинты; ещё одна — октахорд, содержащий всю силу интервала октавы; затем ещё одна — шестнадцатиструнная [система], которая объемлет всё напряжение двойной октавы и обладает двоякими возможностями: ведь она содержит в себе и те, о которых мы только что сказали, и возможности интервалов октавы с квартой, октавы с квинтой и двойной октавы.
quotes.en: Of the systems, one is the tetrachord, which contains all the powers of the interval of the fourth; another the pentachord, which embraces the powers of the interval of the fifth; another the octachord, which contains the whole force of the interval of the octave; another, next, the sixteen-stringed [system], comprising the entire tension of the double octave and having twofold powers: for it contains in itself those which we have just mentioned and also the powers of the intervals of the octave and a fourth, the octave and a fifth, and the double octave.

quotes.ru: Из систем же одна — тетрахорд, который содержит все возможности интервала кварты; другая — пентахорд, который охватывает возможности интервала квинты; ещё одна — октахорд, который содержит всю силу интервала октавы; далее ещё одна — шестнадцатиструнная [система], охватывающая всё напряжение двойной октавы и имеющая двойные возможности: ведь она содержит в себе и те, о которых мы только что сказали, и возможности интервалов октавы с квартой, октавы с квинтой и двойной октавы.
quotes.en: Of the systems, one is the tetrachord, which contains all the capacities of the interval of the fourth; another the pentachord, which embraces the capacities of the interval of the fifth; another the octachord, which contains the whole force of the interval of the octave; another, next, the sixteen-string [system], comprising the entire tension of the double octave and having double capacities: for it contains in itself those that we have just mentioned, and the capacities of the intervals of the octave and a fourth, the octave and a fifth, and the double octave.

readings.construal: The whole range in pitch.

quotes.ru: Одна из систем — тетрахорд, вмещающий все возможности интервала кварты. Другая — пентахорд, охватывающий возможности интервала квинты. Ещё одна — октахорд, заключающий в себе всю силу интервала октавы. Далее идёт шестнадцатиструнная система, охватывающая всю высотную протяжённость двойной октавы и обладающая двоякими возможностями: она вмещает как те, о которых мы только что сказали, так и возможности интервалов октавы с квартой, октавы с квинтой и двойной октавы.
quotes.en: One system is the tetrachord, which contains all the capacities of the fourth. Another is the pentachord, which embraces the capacities of the fifth. Another is the octachord, which contains the entire capacity of the octave. Next comes the sixteen-string system, which spans the full pitch range of the double octave and has two kinds of capacity. For it contains both those just mentioned and the capacities of the octave and a fourth, the octave and a fifth, and the double octave.

readings.construal: The full rise from one end of the system to the other.

quotes.ru: Одна из систем — тетрахорд, заключающий в себе все возможности кварты. Другая — пентахорд, охватывающий возможности квинты. Ещё одна — октахорд, вмещающий всю силу октавы. Далее следует шестнадцатиструнная система, охватывающая весь подъём на двойную октаву. Её возможности двояки. Она заключает в себе как только что перечисленные возможности, так и возможности октавы с квартой, октавы с квинтой и двойной октавы.
quotes.en: One of the systems is the tetrachord, which contains all the capacities of the fourth. Another is the pentachord, which embraces the capacities of the fifth. Another is the octachord, which contains the full power of the octave. Next comes the sixteen-string system, which spans the full rise of the double octave and has a twofold capacity. It contains both the capacities we have just described and those of the octave and a fourth, the octave and a fifth, and the double octave.

text_issues_review.printed: nicum dicimus. Si igitur tonis plurimùm / harmonia peragitur, Diátonon sic voca- / tum efficitur genus: si Hemitoniis, Chro- / maticum: si verò diesibus ferè harmonia / continetur, conficitur, quam Harmonicam / appellant modulationem.
text_issues_review.proposal: (a) 'is for the most part made up of dieses'; (b) 'is held together almost wholly by dieses'.
text_issues_review.why: Fere can mean almost or for the most part. The following omnino makes the almost/entire opposition grammatically possible, but 'almost wholly' implies a stronger numerical or spatial claim than the technical description supports. In V59 two of the three steps are dieses and cover one fifth of the stated compass. 'Chiefly' leaves the basis of predominance implicit.

segments.sense: Two semitones and a trihemitone blended in due proportion form the chromatic genus of the fourth. This genus is sadder and more mournful than the preceding diatonic one.

best_ru.why: The separate comparison sentence clearly refers to the genus.

segments.sense: If melodic movement uses two dieses, the remaining interval is one ditone formed by fusion. This genus of the fourth, regarded as the best, is named harmonic after harmony itself, described as common to all.

divergences.issue: All the genera, all things, or an unqualified all?

readings.construal: Unqualified all, keeping the antecedent implicit.

quotes.ru: Если же мелодия ведётся через две диесы, то остающийся интервал будет одним дитоном, [возникшим] из слияния, и этот род кварты называется гармоническим: как наилучший, он назван по самой гармонии, общей для всех.
quotes.en: But if the melody is carried through two dieses, the interval that remains will be one ditone [arising] from blending, and this genus of the fourth is named harmonic: because it is the best, it has been named after harmony itself, which is common to all.

readings.construal: All the genera, with the addition bracketed.

quotes.ru: Если же мелодическое движение идёт по двум диесам, оставшийся интервал будет одним дитоном, образованным слиянием. Этот род кварты называется гармоническим. Он наилучший и потому получил своё имя от самой гармонии, общей для всех [родов].
quotes.en: If the melodic movement is carried out through two dieses, the remaining interval will be a single ditone formed by merging. This genus of the fourth is called harmonic. Because it is the best, it takes its name from harmony itself, which is common to all [the genera].

quotes.ru: Если же мелодия движется по двум диесам, то оставшимся интервалом будет один дитон, возникший от слияния. Этот род кварты носит имя гармонического, потому что считается наилучшим. Имя он получил от самой гармонии, общей для всех [родов].
quotes.en: If the melody proceeds by two dieses, the remaining interval will be a single ditone formed by blending. This genus of the fourth is called harmonic on the ground that it is the best, taking its name from harmony itself, which all [the genera] share.

readings.construal: All things, taken as cosmic harmony.

quotes.ru: Если же мелодия проходит через две диесы, оставшийся интервал будет одним дитоном, [образованным] слиянием, и этот род кварты называется гармоническим как наилучший, получив прозвание от самой гармонии, общей для всего.
quotes.en: But if the melody proceeds through two dieses, the remaining interval will be a single ditone by fusion, and this genus of the fourth is called harmonic on the ground that it is the best, being named after the very harmony common to all things.

best_en.why: Duly proportions conveys the technical role of temperare without a later tuning implication.

segments.sense: From the single tetrachord just used to illustrate how the component intervals of the fourth are formed, the diligent student can readily understand the construction of the other systems.

best_ru.why: Clear handling of the constituent intervals and a natural sentence division.

best_en.why: “Constituent intervals of a fourth” communicates the relation without needless repetition.

segments.sense: The harmonic genus is the hardest to perform, needs much preparation and practice, and is therefore used less frequently.

segments.sense: Each genus is further varied and distributed among many divisions, differences and kinds of melody. The mode is called Lydian, Phrygian or Dorian. The paean, wedding song, departure song and all kinds of melody can arise from any of the modes.

divergences.issue: Do the generic labels enter as learned names or as intelligible descriptions of song types?

readings.construal: Both names retained as learned forms.

quotes.ru: Каждый же из этих [родов], в свою очередь, видоизменяется и распределяется по многим делениям, различиям и родам мелодий; и лад называется то лидийским, то фригийским, то дорийским; а от каждого из них происходят пеан, гименей, эксодий и все, сколько их есть, роды мелодий.
quotes.en: Each of these, in turn, is varied and distributed into many divisions and differences and genera of melodies; and the mode is called now Lydian, now Phrygian, now Dorian; and from each of these arise the paean, the hymenaeus, the exodius, and all the genera of melodies that there are.

quotes.ru: Каждый же из них, в свою очередь, видоизменяется и распределяется на многие подразделения, различия и роды мелодий: лад называется то лидийским, то фригийским, то дорийским; и от любого из них происходят пеан, гименей, эксодий и все, сколько их ни есть, роды мелодий.
quotes.en: Each of these, in turn, is varied and distributed into many divisions and differences and genera of melody: the mode is called now Lydian, now Phrygian, now Dorian; and from any one of them arise the paean, the hymenaeus, the exodius, and all the genera of melody there are.

readings.construal: Hymenaeus retained and Exodius translated as an exit or closing song.

quotes.ru: Каждый из них, в свою очередь, меняется и распадается на множество подразделений, разновидностей и родов мелодического движения. Лад называется то лидийским, то фригийским, то дорийским. Из любого из них возникают пеан, гименей, заключительная песнь и все прочие роды мелодического движения.
quotes.en: Each of these, in turn, varies and is distributed into many divisions, varieties, and genera of melodic movement. The mode is called now Lydian, now Phrygian, now Dorian. From any of these arise the paean, the hymenaeus, the exit song, and all the other genera of melodic movement.

readings.construal: Wedding song and song of departure, with “farewell song” in Russian.

quotes.ru: Каждый из этих [родов] опять-таки допускает изменения и распадается на множество подразделений, разновидностей и родов мелодии. Лад называют то лидийским, то фригийским, то дорийским. quotes.en: Each of these [genera] again admits of variation and is divided into many subdivisions, varieties and genera of melody. The mode is called now Lydian, now Phrygian, now Dorian. segments.sense: There are limitless varieties of melody. Their means include changes and differences in intervals, slower and rapid transitions, pauses and flow, and varied touches and strokes according to the player’s control of the hand.

divergences.issue: The measure of the hand, or the player’s varying control of it?

readings.construal: The hand’s mode of operation or varying control, with a more literal Russian version in A.

quotes.ru: Ибо не одной только переменой интервалов и не одним только их различием, но также более медленными и стремительными переходами, равно как паузами и течениями, и разнообразными касаниями и ударами, сообразно различной мере [движения] руки, создаются бесчисленные и разнообразные мелодии.
quotes.en: For it is not by change of the intervals alone, nor by their difference alone, but also by slower and by rapid transitions, by pauses too and flowings, and by various touches and strokes, according to the varying control of the hand, that infinite and diverse melodies are produced.

quotes.ru: Бесчисленные и разнообразные мелодические движения получаются не только от перемены интервалов или от различий между ними, но также от более медленных и стремительных переходов, пауз и плавных движений, разных касаний и ударов, в зависимости от того, как действует рука.
quotes.en: Countless and varied forms of melodic movement are produced by changes and differences of interval, and also by slower and more rapid transitions, pauses and flowing movements, and various touches and strokes, depending on how the hand is controlled.

quotes.ru: Не только смена интервалов и различия между ними порождают бесконечное множество самых разных мелодий. К этому ведут и переходы, то более медленные, то стремительные, и паузы, и непрерывное движение, и разнообразные прикосновения и удары, смотря по тому, как ими управляет рука.
quotes.en: For melodies of infinite number and variety are produced by changes of interval and by differences between intervals, but also by slower and more animated transitions, by pauses and passages of flowing movement, and by varied touches and strokes according to the varying control of the hand.

readings.construal: The varied measure of the hand, with movements supplied in Russian.

quotes.ru: Ведь не одним только изменением интервалов и не одним только их различием, но и более медленными и стремительными переходами, а также паузами и течениями, и различными касаниями и ударами, сообразно различной мере [движений] руки, создаются бесчисленные и разнообразные мелодии.
quotes.en: For not by the change of intervals alone, nor by their difference alone, but also by slower and quicker transitions, by pauses too and flowings, and by various touches and strokes, according to the varied measure of the hand, are infinite and diverse melodies produced.

term_inconsistencies.problem: X37 uses «количества звуков или струн», whereas X38 specifies «[порядковый номер]» and «номера предшествующих звуков». The connected proof compares position numbers. X39’s «число звуков» also allows the misleading reading of a count.

X04 gives «пропорциональность» and “proportionality”, while X32 gives «взаимных пропорциях» and “their mutual proportions”. Keep this term distinct from the nearby ratio vocabulary and from proportio.

X04 gives «пропорциональность» and “proportionality”, while X32 gives «во взаимных пропорциях» and “in their mutual proportions”. A phrase for corresponding proportions can render the plural while retaining the distinction from proportio.

English X56 has “any other genera of melody” and X57 “kinds of tune” in the same discussion of types of song. A consistent word for ordinary kinds would distinguish both passages from the technical three genera.
X56 has «роды мелодий» and “genera of melodies”, while X57 has «виды напевов» and “kinds of tune”. In Russian the latter also loses the distinction from species, rendered «видов» earlier at X56.
V32 has “the force of many intervals” and V49 “the entire capacity of the octave”. The latter merges vis with facultas, also rendered “capacity”, precisely where the two words alternate.

by_translator.strengths: Preserves marked source wording and often distinguishes nearby Latin terms. The notes on the inclusive ratios in V22 and the divergences between the additive counts and exact ratios in V39 are useful. A keeps V59’s common to all open and draws attention to the distinct forms of the compound ratio at X36 and V40.
by_translator.weaknesses: Close English calques can change a technical assertion, most clearly in saying that eight and thirty-two cannot be squared at V27. At X07 a note turns the gifts of music into a threefold classification. A’s doubt at V17 incorrectly makes mese the only single-word name in the list. Tension also becomes opaque where intensio denotes pitch or the compass of an interval, especially at V45 and V49.

by_translator.strengths: Usually gives readable technical prose and consistently exposes the arithmetic behind the ratio brackets. The rendering of duplo acutius at V22 makes clear that the size of an upward step is doubled. B handles the pitch compass at V49 and the semitone-versus-single-step distinction at V57 well.
by_translator.weaknesses: Explanatory recasting sometimes changes the structure of the example. X15 suggests one physical instrument contains another, the English at X28 loses part of the pairing of names, and the Russian at X37 uses the number of sounds or strings as a count where the argument needs ordinal positions. The English at V49 gives vis the same equivalent as facultates, obscuring Vinet’s change of word.

by_translator.strengths: Tracks lexical differences between the two Latin versions and gives especially detailed accounts of the printed diagrams. The explicit fraction at V42 and the Paeeon note at V64 are particularly useful. C regularly preserves awkward features of the reading text and supplies interpretive alternatives separately.
by_translator.weaknesses: Some literal or learned terms make distinctions less accessible in either language, as with melos at V32 and the measure of the hand at V65. English commensurability at V03–V05 is narrower than the context requires. The claim about the unique status of mese at V17 is false. The running text can also commit to an interpretation the syntax leaves open, as with cosmic harmony at V59.

by_translator.strengths: Often gives the strongest reading base in both languages. D is particularly clear on pitch and accord in V11 and V15, the contrast between the ratios of pitches and positions at V44, and the difference between intervals and material systems. D’s V27 note correctly distinguishes division in two from an unrestricted partition into equal squares.
by_translator.weaknesses: Idiomatic supplementation sometimes makes a choice that requires brackets or narrows the Latin, as with the instrument at V18 and the explicit causal connection in Russian at V39. The V42 note gives an inferred count among the printed numerals. In the performance vocabulary, X57’s Russian makes fluxus specifically uninterrupted, and V65’s English loses the limiting expression that supports but also.

overall.summary: D and B most often provide the clearest running prose. A and C offer especially useful notes on verbal distinctions, the arithmetic and the printing. The best base varies by segment and by language. In the opening, preserve Xylander’s commensuratio and proportionalitas beside Vinet’s symmetria and proportio. In the definitions, let the reader see the difference between Xylander’s participation in harmony and Vinet’s capacity to accord. Keep the expressly different note names and explain the shared eighth position behind the fifteen- and sixteen-string counts. Distinguish the additive pitches marked in Vinet’s diagram from exact equal divisions of a ratio. Keep the anomalous remainder in the fourth and explain how it relates to the later tetrachord division. The editor should review the proposed readings at X23–X24, the timing argument at X32 and V37, the status of quod at V18 and the scope of omnium at V59. A note should identify the ratios and the actual visible marks in the diagrams and distinguish any supplied identifications. Claims about sources that the reviewers could not open remain unverified.
